name: How involved will I be in the custom home building process?

mainEntity.name: How involved will I be in the custom home building process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your involvement in the custom home building process is entirely up to you, though we encourage active participation. We value your input at every stage, from initial design concepts and material selections to walkthroughs during construction. Our project managers will keep you informed with regular updates and scheduled meetings. You'll have opportunities to approve plans, make choices, and ask questions, ensuring the final product perfectly matches your expectations and desires.
acceptedAnswer.description: Your involvement is flexible, but we encourage active participation in design, material selection, and walkthroughs, keeping you informed throughout.
